description: Compressor: the four Eagan Matrix compressor controls, each with a jack, matching the compressor in the Haken Editor

params.text: Sets the level the compressor starts working at, 0 to 127
Sets how fast the compressor responds, 0 to 127
Sets how hard the compressor squeezes, 0 to 127
Sets how much of the compressed signal is heard, 0 to 100%
Switches the knob beside it between absolute and relative control voltage: absolute makes a patched cable set the value on its own, relative adds the cable to the knob

inputs.text: Sets the threshold from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the attack from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the ratio from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on
Sets the mix from a cable, 0V to 10V on its own or added to the knob when its relative button is on

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it needs an HC-1 in the patch, which it finds by itself, so it can be placed anywhere in the rack rather than beside it
the light at the top follows the compressor mix

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob beside it.
